purpose: Use the trilogy's ensemble structure so gameplay follows the character who actually carries the film action, while Frodo remains the Ring-quest center rather than the only playable viewpoint.
rules: FILM_CORE scene order, participants and outcome are verified from the available film/script source before implementation.
When the film already gives another character a meaningful action, convert that action into gameplay before inventing filler.
Original expansion is limited to safe gaps around verified scenes: scouting, preparation, travel, training, local help, craft, investigation, survival or conversation.
A side mission may never pull a character away from their next required film scene.
Every optional expansion yields immediately when the next mandatory film beat begins.

production_rule: Each mission must be bound to verified opening/closing film anchors before runtime implementation. FUTURE_SOURCE_CHECK entries are not implementation authority until verified.
non_negotiable_rules: Choose the playable viewpoint from the verified film event; Frodo is not mandatory when another character carries the action.
FILM_CORE scene order, participants and outcome must follow the verified film/script source.
A character may not enter optional content if that would remove them from a required film scene.
When the film already provides meaningful action, convert the film action into gameplay before adding original gap-fill.
Original gap-fill is limited to safe scouting, preparation, travel, training, local help, craft, investigation, survival or conversation windows.
Every optional expansion yields immediately when the next mandatory film beat begins.

preferred_order: character-specialty gameplay in the same verified window
small original gap-fill only if still useful
forbidden: moving a character out of a required film scene
